messages.subject: Display node ages on tree
parts:
Hi Nick,

I used BioGeoBEARS for the ancestral state reconstruction. Everything is running fine (thanks for your recommendation regarding the pdf size).

But...I would like to display the ages of all nodes on the tree. I know this is more a general question, not directly concerning BioGeoBEARS, but I can't find the relevant command. Maybe, you have an idea?

Thanks,

Kristina

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Display node ages on tree
parts:
Hi Kristina,

Thanks for the question. The function prt() might help you, it converts the tree into a table so you can get information like that. So for Psychotria it might be something like:

trtable = prt(tr)

plot(tr)
ages_to_plot = trtable$time_bp[20:37]
nodelabels(ages_to_plot)
axisPhylo()

...I forget exactly, but something like that. Cheers!
Nick
